title: Grêmio seeks decisive home victory against Vasco
seoTitle: Grêmio vs Vasco: Decisive home match for Série A
subtitle: The clash could define the Tricolor's stay in Série A
excerpt: Grêmio faces Vasco this Thursday at home, in one of seven crucial matches to avoid relegation.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Grêmio faces Vasco this Thursday, at the Arena, in one of seven clashes that could define the Tricolor's stay in Série A. With 28 points, the club needs three points to secure its permanence in the Brasileirão elite.

Why the clash is high-stakes

The game against Vasco marks Grêmio's first decisive home match. The club has not yet won away from the Arena and has seven matches remaining in the season, with 21 points all up for grabs. The match could be crucial for moving away from the relegation zone.

Grêmio's home objective

Grêmio has the ninth-best home performance in the Brasileirão (66.6%), with seven wins, three draws, and two losses. If they maintain this average in the seven remaining games, they could earn 13 of the 21 available points and reach 41 points, a total that also requires points away from the Arena to ensure permanence.

Crowd and atmosphere expectations

The projected crowd for the game is between 25,000 and 30,000 people. The club aims to replicate the atmosphere created at the Arena during the Copa do Brasil Gre-Nal, where over 55,000 fans were present. Goalkeeper Weverton and defender Wallace called for fan support to create a decisive atmosphere.

Grêmio's remaining schedule

  • 16/9 – Grêmio vs Vasco – Arena
  • 16/9 – Botafogo vs Grêmio – Nilton Santos
  • 20/9 – Grêmio vs Palmeiras – Arena
  • 7/10 – Remo vs Grêmio – Mangueirão
  • 11/10 – Grêmio vs Inter – Arena
  • 18/10 – Grêmio vs Cruzeiro – Arena
  • 25/10 – Coritiba vs Grêmio – Couto Pereira
  • 28/10 – Grêmio vs Athletico – Arena
  • 4/11 – Flamengo vs Grêmio – Maracanã
  • 18/11 – Grêmio vs Bahia – Arena
  • 22/11 – Santos vs Grêmio – Vila Belmiro
  • 29/11 – Corinthians vs Grêmio – Neo Química Arena
  • 2/12 – Grêmio vs Mirassol – Arena
